forbidden.name: not-to-unresolvable

forbidden.name: no-circular
forbidden.comment: No runtime dependency cycles (monorepo-architecture.md rule 7, DECISIONS D15). A cycle made only of type imports (`import type`, `import("…").T`) erases at compile time, so it is allowed.
